messages:
Alice M (Product): Heads-up — ACME wants per-tenant prewarm for private deploys. Need to scope a Q2 pilot. TL;DR: support ~500 concurrent sessions, p95 <150ms target, and KMS integration for keys.

Ben R (Runtime): Noted. Quick clarifying Qs: is 500 concurrent steady-state or burst? Also need model size and typical sequence length distribution.

Fiona (CS): It's bursty — daytime spikes, ~10x bursts for 10-15m windows. Model is a 13B open model, typical seq len ~1024. Customer expects low latency during bursts.

Carla I (Infra): For Private we'll need capacity/throughput changes + VPC peering and NAT sizing. Ballpark: add 2 g5 instances for pilot unless runtime batching saves the day.

Ben R (Runtime): For 13B @1024 with that burst profile, we need prefix/KV caching and adaptive batching. Without caching p95 will blow past 150ms. Can Product accept a softened SLA for pilot (200ms) and iterate?

Alice M (Product): Customer pushed hard on 150ms SLA in contract talks. But we might negotiate phased SLA: pilot at 200ms, commit to 150ms within 3 months if metrics hold.

Deepa S (Security): KMS integration OK but they want HSM-backed keys and audit trails. That adds a compliance chunk: threat model + pentest window. ETA 3-4 weeks for full HSM setup.

Evan (SRE): Observability ask: per-route latency, token-level cost breakdown, and alerts for >10% p50 regression. Need tracing hooks in runtime; can we get sampling to reduce telemetry volume?

Ben R (Runtime): We can expose tracing hooks and token-cost metadata, but infra needs to store/aggregate. Carla, can infra handle the ingestion volume with sampling?

Carla I (Infra): Yes with sampling/aggregation. Work estimate: infra capacity + logging pipeline changes ~2 weeks dev + 1 week QA.

Fiona (CS): Customer timeline is tight — wants pilot end of Q2 (~6 weeks). With current backlog that feels compressed.

Alice M (Product): Risk noted. Proposal to hit timeline: reduce pilot scope — no HSM in pilot (use software KMS with added logging), pilot SLA 200ms with documented SLO roadmap to 150ms. Security sign-off required for soft-KMS fallback.

Deepa S (Security): Soft-KMS for pilot is acceptable if keys are isolated per-tenant and extra audit logging is enabled. Final sign-off requires a pentest scheduled during the pilot window.

Ben R (Runtime): OK. Concrete action items from runtime side: prototype prefix caching + adaptive batching; include canary routing + auto-fallback to smaller-model variant in rollout plan. Estimate 2 weeks for prototype, 1 week for canary wiring.

Carla I (Infra): Action items: capacity plan + VPC/NAT config + logging pipeline sampling. 2 weeks dev + 1 week staging QA. Need explicit rollback plan if latency spikes.

Evan (SRE): I'll own dashboards, alerts, and the runbook for cache eviction storms and degraded fallback. 1 week to put dashboards in place if runtime provides traces.

Fiona (CS): I'll sync with ACME on phased SLA and get written customer acceptance criteria. Also will confirm burst profile telemetry.

Alice M (Product): Summary of decisions: pilot scope reduced (software KMS), SLA = 200ms for pilot, commitment to 150ms within 3 months, HSM + pentest planned post-pilot. Everyone ok?

Carla I (Infra): Agree, with the caveat that we need a rollback & capacity throttle plan.

Ben R (Runtime): Agree. I'll include adaptive batching thresholds and canary autoswap to lower-cap model in the PRD.

Evan (SRE): Agree. I'll add SLOs and runbook to the PRD.

Deepa S (Security): I'll kick off the risk assessment and book pentest slot; will confirm if any hard blockers emerge.

Alice M (Product): I'll write the decision doc & PRD this afternoon, include the action tracker and tentative timeline. Action owner recap: Ben (runtime prototype), Carla (infra & logging), Deepa (KMS risk + pentest), Evan (SRE dashboards & runbook), Fiona/Alice (customer comms + SLA doc).

Fiona (CS): I'll notify customer of phased plan and get acceptance criteria.

Alice M (Product): Thanks all :thumbsup: deploy-bot: scheduled meeting created for "ACME pilot kickoff" next Monday 10am.

deploy-bot: Meeting created by Alice M (Product) — ACME pilot kickoff — Mon 10:00am — link: https://calendar.company/meet/ACME-pilot

Alice M (Product): Sending PRD link shortly. If anyone has urgent concerns DM me.

Ben R (Runtime): Adding a small note — if we see high eviction rates, first mitigation is to increase KV cache retention and enable prewarm for top N prefixes.

Carla I (Infra): I'll draft rollback knobs (capacity decrease, route draining, model fallback).

Evan (SRE): I'll pair with Ben to wire alerts into oncall rota.

Alice M (Product): Perfect. Closing thread, PRD will be at https://docs.company/prd/acme-prewarm once posted.
